name: The Charles Hotel
positioning: Rocco Forte hotel in Munich's Lenbachgärten quarter near Königsplatz, with views over the Old Botanical Garden and an Italian restaurant, Florio
best_for: Travelers who want suites with garden, rooftop or Alpine views over Munich
Families wanting rooms with separate bedrooms for parents and children
Guests who enjoy Italian dining and an aperitivo bar on site

facts.text: The hotel is set within the Lenbachgärten quarter, close to the historic Königsplatz in Munich.
The hotel's address is Sophienstrasse 28, 80333 Munich.
Most of the suites overlook the Old Botanical Garden and the historic rooftops of Munich.
Deluxe Park View Rooms have French balconies and botanical accents inspired by the Old Botanical Garden.
The Monforte Royal Suite is named after Lord Forte's birthplace and has a private terrace.
Two-Bedroom Family Rooms have separate bedrooms for parents and children.
Florio Bar is an Italian aperitivo bar with a plant-filled interior and botanical frescoes leading to the terrace.
Circle Bar has an Art Deco backdrop by Paolo Moschino and a library of books.
Circle Bar's Champagne list includes both internationally renowned labels and boutique producers.
The hotel hosts meetings and events, from galas to business meetings.

highlights.text: The Lord Forte Suite has a private terrace with views of the Old Botanical Garden, Munich's rooftops and the Alps.
Deluxe Panoramic View Rooms have views over Munich including the Old Botanical Garden and, on clear days, the Alps.
Circle Bar is named in homage to Mauro Staccioli's Ring sculpture outside the hotel.
Florio serves classic Italian food with a menu created by Fulvio Pierangelini.
Florio has a dining room and terrace with views over the Old Botanical Garden.

considerations.text: There is no dress code in the restaurants, but guests are asked to avoid sportswear, shorts and beach shoes; smart-casual is typical.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the modern aesthetic may not appeal to traditional luxury seekers.
